name: Necromancer: Frigid Winds raises Refreshing Chill's proc chance from 20% to 25% (#834)
contract: Frigid Winds 504357 (CharacterAdvancement 7213, Rime tab) reads 'Increases the chance to trigger Refreshing Chill by $s1%.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 18 (SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS), EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5, class mask (0, 0, 0x40000000) in SpellFamilyName 29, which selects Refreshing Chill 300940 (family flags 0, 0, 0x40000000; ProcChance 20; 'Casting Command spells now has a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of Ice Barrage and make your cast next within $800979d instant cast.'). No other SpellFamilyName 29 spell carries SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS, and no other Necromancer Chance() talent matches the mask. The core applies this modifier to an aura's proc chance in Aura::CalcProcChance, but Refreshing Chill is script-driven (ApplyContracts turns its PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL effect into a dummy): AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp rolls Chance(player, 300940) on every non-triggered Command cast, and AscensionNecromancer.cpp Chance() rolled the raw ProcChance, so Frigid Winds never counted and the chance stayed 20%. Chance() now applies SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS to the talent's chance, as Pyromancer and Starcaller already do, making it 25%. A proc casts 800979 on the Necromancer, which spell_cast_count counts. Command: Bonefreeze 504489 is a Command (family flags 0, 0, 0x1000000) with no global cooldown (StartRecoveryCategory 0), 300 Runic Power and a 20 s cooldown the fixture resets; a ground-targeted spell defaults its destination to the caster, and a Lesser Skeletal Warrior satisfies the Command's minion requirement. Over 3600 Commands the count of Refreshing Chill procs is Binomial(3600, p): p = 0.20 gives mean 720 (sd 24.0) and p = 0.25 gives mean 900 (sd 26.0). The window [810, 1000] contains a 20% outcome with probability 1.2e-4 (exact binomial) and misses a 25% outcome with probability 2.8e-4; a doubled +10 modifier (30%, mean 1080) lands inside it with probability 1.8e-3.
